confidence_notes: Food and beer estimates are informed by [Numbeo's Cardiff prices](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Cardiff). Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain, guided by their relationship to beer and local [cocktail](https://bonnierogues.co.uk/cardiff/cocktails/) and [wine](https://www.ginandjuice.com/menus/cardiff/gin-menu-cardiff-.pdf) menus. Accommodation figures are holistic July estimates; weekends and events can substantially affect prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bristol and Birmingham provide a broad regional UK city basis, with Cardiff's summer tourism and event demand considered for accommodation.
